signatures: CommandHandler: { name, description, execute(args) => Effect<CommandResult, CommandParseError> }
error_modes: CommandParseError when the requested Provider id is invalid
invariants: `/model` with no args MUST display the active RoutingPreference
`/model auto` MUST clear the active RoutingPreference

responsibilities: Expose deterministic RoutingPreference control through Command dispatch
Keep Command parsing separate from ProviderRouter scoring
prohibited: MUST NOT mutate ProviderRouter internals directly
MUST NOT accept unknown Provider ids
MUST NOT persist RoutingPreference outside RoutingPreferences service
